units: seeds and complete randomized ABBA or BAAB blocks; an incomplete block is missing, never a unit
contrast: a paired log contrast per complete block
strata: class and posture strata, each run on one host pair or host set, with the owner and the standby or control roles counterbalanced by the campaign driver, which no judge checks
pilot: pilot runs are disjoint from held-out confirmation runs, and no pilot run counts toward confirmation

bounds.per_tail: familywise_alpha / (2 m), m the policy family's member count

edge_interval: Wilson score interval at the per-tail level; descriptive, its nominal coverage assumes independent requests
censoring: a timeout is censored at its deadline and ranks above every completed latency; the hit gate's samples format records no timeout or deadline, so each outcome's tail holds its completed latencies uncensored and a cell holding errors reads inconclusive
attempts: original requests and attempts are counted apart; one terminal bucket per original request
repeatability: the run identity and the raw evidence digests reproduce every reported value
hit_latency: the hit gate's protocol: its A/A band, ABBA and BAAB block contrasts, ceilings and hit floor
block_contrast: per complete block and member, d = (ln B1 + ln B2 - ln A1 - ln A2) / 2 over the block's four positions, signed so that a positive d is worse in the member's direction; a member with levels takes one contrast per level, and a block with a position off its seeded order, on an unadmitted host, naming no class or, in a class contrast, running the cold class outside the null set, or holding a missing or non-positive value is missing for that member
order_bound: a distribution-free bound on the median contrast: the k-th smallest and k-th largest of n contrasts, k the largest count with P(Binomial(n, 1/2) < k) at most the per-tail level, which a member with L levels divides by L and S declared class and posture comparison strata divide by S; with no such k the bound is unbounded, and a censored contrast bounds only the side its censoring keeps
pilot_floor: held-out blocks per class and posture stratum and member: the fewest n at which the order bound's upper side is at most the tolerance with at least the power's probability when the contrasts are normal with median zero and the pilot contrasts' standard deviation, a planning power the fixed horizon must also reach; the tolerance is ln(1 + smallest effect / the pilot's arm A median) for a lower-is-better member and -ln(1 - smallest effect / that median) for a higher-is-better one, and a censored pilot value leaves both unsized. The floor sizes the non-inferiority side alone and gives no power to the target's improvement
bound_verdict: PASS when the campaign stands, every control's outcome and the block and calibration values are derived from their evidence, the frame's envelope and population are frozen, alpha and power are accepted, every family member's upper bound is at most its tolerance and the cited target's member holds an upper bound below zero under its posture; UNACCEPTABLE_REGRESSION when the campaign stands, its controls standing or underived, and any member's lower bound exceeds its tolerance; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise, which never merges as a performance change. H takes the hit gate's verdict between the unpatched baseline and the candidate; the request tail takes none, the hit gate bounding hit latency alone
drift: a calibration quantity's uncertainty is the half-width, in its unit, of the interval the driver declares to hold it; its relative drift ranges from max(0, |end - start| - both half-widths) / (start + its half-width) to (|end - start| + both half-widths) / (start - its half-width), and it is stable when the largest is at most the drift band, drifted when the smallest exceeds it, and unresolved otherwise or when the start's half-width reaches the start
